items.title: Weather: richer /weather experience toward MSN-style forecast detail (location, conditions, and supporting metrics)
items.traces_goal: Enhance cpdeol.com /weather so it is more featured with forecast richness comparable to MSN Brampton-style pages (clear location, current conditions, and useful secondary metrics using Open-Meteo or current provider).

definition_of_done: /weather presents a more featured layout: resolved location label, current conditions beyond a single temperature line, and at least wind and humidity (or equivalent MSN-parity metrics) from existing APIs without new secrets in the client.
Loading, success, and error states remain clear; design-system tokens only; no hardcoded hex.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
